object_class: bounded self-hosted Windows recovery execution and exact-return collection
purpose: Execute the exact V3 R1 recovery package on the repository owner's self-hosted Windows recovery seat, preserve a privacy-bounded machine receipt, and return only the package-governed deterministic collection for provenance-aware receiving intake.

actors.self_hosted_windows_recovery_seat: executes the exact package with its local Windows authority
actors.source_custody: binds package identity, workflow scope, result classification, and privacy controls
actors.receiving_intake: independently determines exact-object and provenance standing after return
actors.operator: retains authority over File Library export metadata and visual acceptance
actors.release_authority: retains merge, release, Pages, public-route, and product-mutation authority

workflow_scope.trigger: push to the exact execution branch or explicit workflow dispatch
workflow_scope.network_use: exact package acquisition and Actions artifact return only

execution_sequence: verify Windows host and administrator context
download and verify exact V3 R1 package
execute package-owned accepted-parent and remaining-input recovery lanes
classify the return collection without promoting it
retain privacy-bounded execution summary and package-governed return collection

expected_return.standing: candidate return only until provenance-aware V2 receiving intake
expected_return.permitted_payload: fixed-identity exact objects, PUBLIC_CONVERGENCE candidates, recognized safe envelopes, and package-generated manifests only
